meta.name: 病愈连练7天
meta.placeholder: a heroic and joyful chibi girl with long black hair and big sparkling anime eyes, wearing an elegant dress with flowing mint-green ribbons, holding her polished bamboo flute high like a victory torch. A small pink bandage styled like a cute heart is wrapped neatly on her tiny finger, fading into floating sparkling golden pixels to represent full healing, surrounded by a massive burst of shimmering holographic stars, rising phoenix feathers, and colorful musical notes floating into the sky The scene marks a triumphant one-week recovery milestone, with a small celebration flame rising from the flute tip and a single phoenix feather ascending.
meta.zh_story: 病愈后坚持7天。喉咙还有点哑，但手一天都没停——像举火炬，像发誓。爸妈在旁边拍红了手掌，没说出口的话全在那掌声里：欢迎回来，我们的小笛手。
meta.cond_text: 宝宝生病痊愈后坚持恢复竹笛练习 7 天
